gate.completedLiveSession: A live session (valid daily file with a receipt of class live) whose every prediction has OD1 outcomes for both h=1 and h=5 with status complete or unavailable (with a reason), none pending, and no anomaly flag. A missing or incomplete capture never counts.
gate.note: 250 is a minimum review gate, not a guarantee of statistical significance. The system never unblinds on its own; unblinding needs the user's explicit authorisation.

note: A governance control. The repository and market prices are public, so this seal does not make results unknowable; it prevents the system from computing or displaying live performance before authorisation.
